# washr

Repo for R scripts to download and clean open sanitation data

# Package index

## All functions

- [`jmpindicators`](https://github.com/openwashdata/jmpinput/reference/jmpindicators.md)
  : jmpindicators: Modelled WASH Indicator Estimates from the WHO/UNICEF
  JMP
- [`jmpraw`](https://github.com/openwashdata/jmpinput/reference/jmpraw.md)
  : jmpraw: Survey-Level Sanitation Input Data from the WHO/UNICEF JMP
